description: Design, review and confirm the WHOLE season of a series before any episode is made. Free (no credits). Founder rules: a series is fully designed and reviewed before any video is produced, and its characters, voice and style are fixed in every episode. Three steps, one tool: (1) pass `plan` to save it (version 1: logline, genre, language, narratorVoiceId, styleTokens, characters[] with look, sheetId and wardrobeLock, rules[], at least 3 episodes[] with title, characterName, cliffhangerLine and shots[] or a script). Every edit clears the review and the confirmation. (2) pass `review: true` (with or without `plan`) to run the season review: a deterministic checklist (cliffhangers, hooks, one narrator and style, no on-screen text, one subject per look and per shot, outfit locked, season price) plus an advisory AI review that lists up to 8 concrete issues; if the AI review cannot run the answer says so and the checklist stands. (3) show the owner the checklist, the AI issues and the season price, and ONLY after they say yes call again with `confirm: true` and `planHash` from the review. Every character an episode uses needs a READY sheet of this series (autoshort_create_character_sheet, one sheet per character) whose id is in the plan. Then autoshort_quote_character_episode / autoshort_create_character_episode make the planned episodes.

aiReview.description: With review: also run the advisory AI review (default true).

confirm.description: The owner confirms the reviewed plan. Needs planHash; do not send `plan` in the same call.

plan.description: The whole season plan. Omit to review or confirm the stored one.

look.description: ONE character: age band, hair, outfit, one prop. Never two characters in one look.

sheetId.description: The READY character sheet of THIS series that plays this character.

wardrobeLock.description: The outfit, identical in every episode ("natural fur, no clothes" for an animal).

characterName.description: The ONE character of the cast this episode stars.

cliffhangerLine.description: The LAST spoken sentence of every episode but the last.

script.description: The narration the system splits into shots. Give `script` OR `shots`.

action.description: What the viewer sees: ONE character, one action. Never on-screen text.

camera.description: Camera: shot size and one move.

narration.description: What the narrator says over this shot.

language.description: The narration language of every episode: 'en', 'vi'... (never auto).

narratorVoiceId.description: The narrator of every episode: an ElevenLabs voice id or a Google voice name such as en-US-Chirp3-HD-Aoede.

styleTokens.description: One short phrase appended to every shot prompt, e.g. "cinematic, moody teal light, 35mm film".

planHash.description: With confirm: the planHash the review returned.

review.description: Run the season review on the stored plan (after saving `plan` if given).

name: autoshort_save_season_plan
